integrity: The finite proof is analytical; a standalone script verifies exact low-order cases and independent numerical comparisons. No independent mathematical or bibliographic validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The finite sharp norm is an elementary cap-moment prescription rather than one rational expression in polygon order. title: Sharp affine least-squares stability on regular polygons and its disk-limit defect
